				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p style="text-align: center;">Located right on the beach at the bottom of the La Ventana bay. We are in one of the best and most popular kiting areas for a reason. With welcoming sandy beaches and consistent wind through the winter, our spot is second to none. Our hotel gear shed is located right on the beach, so you can rig up and go and our kiteschool, <a href="http://www.elevationkiteboarding.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Elevation Kiteboarding</a>, is located right next to it. If you would like to take some lessons, rent some gear, have a refresher or learn a new trick it&#8217;s all at your fingertips!!</p>								</div>
